questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
passageText: I would like to talk about the time when I visited a Japan last summer. It was the incredible experience because I got to see the Mount Fuji. In my opinion, the nature in Japan is very beautiful, and I think every person should visit this country at least once in the lifetime.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'This country' is correct — 'this' functions as a demonstrative determiner referring to Japan.

errors.explanation: Do not use any article before country names. 'Japan' needs no article.
First mention of 'experience' — use indefinite article 'an' (before a vowel sound).
Do not use 'the' before proper nouns like mountain names with 'Mount'. Say 'Mount Fuji'.
